context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_jansetu_backend.py is the regression suite (26 tests, all green). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_jansetu_backend.py -v. Issue POST body uses {category,title,description}; assign uses {assigned_to}; status uses {status} as JSON body; notifications need {title,body,notif_type,scope}; visits need {title,location,date,time,visit_type}; devworks need {title,description,location,category,status}; area create needs {kind,name,code,constituency_id,region_type}; citizen register needs {mobile,name,gender,kind,region_type,ward_id,house_number,address}. Frontend citizen flow end-to-end works on production URL. Did NOT exhaustively test staff/PA/admin UI flows (assign worker via dropdown, schedule visit form, notifications compose, devworks add, admin areas+staff pages, citizens 360°) due to time — backend coverage confirms the underlying APIs work; recommend a quick smoke pass on those staff UI flows next.
